answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Admired dentist registration with dental council attestation changes that arithmetic: a registration the council renews after surgery audits, so the sonnet for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the cedar is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the knoll of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
